name: Rain of Feathers
source:
Two kingdoms, Canines and Avians, celebrate a festival where the Avians will drop a feather on the kingdom of wolves and spend time with each other as a sign of peace.

This was due to two powerful people: a wolf prince and a bird gifted by the gods with great power. In the tale of their history, they are the ones who mended the relationship between the two kingdoms.

But what really happened?

Roberto and Jacob, a crow and a wolf from their own kingdom, respectively. Have been best friends since childhood, ever since Roberto had his first Rain of Feathers festival. But over time, he grew an affection with Jacob and now has to deal with the truth that they are to discover about the powerful people of their shared history.

[From [url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/rain-of-feathers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
犬科动物和鸟类王国这两个王国庆祝一个节日，鸟类王国将向狼王国扔一根羽毛，并与彼此共度时光，以示和平。

这要归功于两个强大的人：狼王子和神赐予强大力量的鸟。在他们的历史故事中，他们是修复两个王国之间关系的人。

但到底发生了什么？

罗伯托和雅各布，分别是来自他们自己王国的乌鸦和狼。自从罗伯托第一次举办羽毛雨节以来，我们就一直是最好的朋友。但随着时间的推移，他对雅各布产生了感情，现在必须面对这样一个事实：他们将发现他们共同历史上的有权势的人。

[来自[url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/rain-of-feathers]Itch.io[/url]]
